scientific_integrity: All structural and enumeration assertions have a written proof. Finite tests check the \(s=2\) prime-field examples only, with larger parameters checked by integer formula evaluation. No code execution is asserted for unavailable fields.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to \(2s\)-dimensional faithful modules over a fixed split square-zero algebra with radical dimension \(s^2-1\), all prime-power fields and \(s\ge2\). Source-algebra automorphisms are not included in module isomorphism. The Schur-Jacobson minimum-degree bound is prior knowledge; residual specialized matrix-space-orbit coverage risk remains. Independent mathematical validation was not performed.
title: Defect-one faithful modules of split square-zero local algebras over finite fields
